What if a T. rex chased you like in Jurassic Park?
In the movie, it keeps up with a speeding jeep.
But in 2017, scientists built a computer model of its skeleton.
If it tried to run, its leg bones would likely break under its own weight.
So it probably couldn't run at all. It could only walk.
But here's the problem. Its legs were huge, so even walking, it may have hit almost twenty eight kilometers per hour.
Most people can only sprint about twenty five, and only for a few seconds.
Usain Bolt topped out at about forty five.
But you? You'd better find a really good hiding spot.
